title_original: 헌법재판소법 제19조제4항제5호의 연구기관의 범위에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of these Rules is to define the scope of accredited research institutes, including universities, delegated under Article 19 (4) 5 of the Constitutional Court Act.
